name: Welterman International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Welterman International Ltd is in the business of leather and fertilizers
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Company manufacturers leather soles (with technical assistance from MA-MECC from Italy), rubber soles, TPR, TPU & PVC soles, specialized injected soles and leather soles with Masonite heels. It has computerized designing and pattern making studio.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
